lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Thursday, 11:42 PM. The Mercer house.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Front door was unlocked. It's never unlocked.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Mom? ...Mom!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No answer. Just the hum of the refrigerator, and sodium-orange streetlight spilling through a broken window.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Okay. Breathe. Before I call anyone, I need to see what happened here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Click an object, or move between objects with Tab or the arrow keys and press Enter. Hold H to highlight everything. I = Inventory, J = Journal, Esc = Menu.]

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: The kitchen. They barely touched it in here.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Every drawer yanked open, and the fridge still humming like nothing happened.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The flashlight beam slides under the couch frame and catches something pale.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: A feather? It's warm. Like it was just...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Away from the beam it keeps glowing: faint, gold, steady.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere outside, a church bell rings once. There's no church on this street.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Okay. That's not normal.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Glass blown out onto the porch. The spare key gone. Not a scratch on the lock.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: And a feather that glows in the dark.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: None of this fits a normal break-in. I need to lay it all out before I walk out that door.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Open the Deduction Board with B, or from the Journal.]

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: No glass on the carpet. No marks on the lock. And the spare key's gone.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: They didn't break in. They let themselves in with our key, then smashed the window from the inside so it would look like they did.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Somebody wanted the police to see a random burglary.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Deduction solved. The front door is the way forward.]

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Whoever did this knew where we keep the spare key. They knew this house.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: And they knew Mom would be here tonight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Eli steps onto the porch. Glass crunches underfoot. He pulls the door shut behind him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Down the street, the streetlight flickers once and goes dark. Somewhere, a church bell answers.
